grh_835444dd58cb59d3e83d.title: Golden Bells
paragraphs: Exhausted after a night with a sick child, Dr. Christian dozes in his office while worrying that he has promised a fresh story for a children's Valentine party. In his brief sleep he is summoned by a fairy from a second plane of existence and carried by magic carpet through a comic fantasy world of operators, trolls, fairies and strange rules to a golden palace where a young prince is in severe pain. Christian learns that the prince had visited the human world and eaten unripe apples. The court's mysterious magical illness turns out to be an ordinary stomachache, and a simple first-plane remedy quickly puts the prince right. The grateful fairy kingdom sends Christian home with a souvenir. He wakes after only a few minutes and tells Judy the whole impossible adventure as the new story for the children. Judy dismisses it as a dream, until Christian produces the physical souvenir he was given in the fantasy world.

grh_831fc8f430ca3d2d96a7.title: Two Is Company
paragraphs: In Sicily, Harry meets wealthy grocery heir Gus Schmidt, whose fiancée Emily Hickenlooper loves him but rejects the unromantic grocery life. Harry enlists notorious bandit Batzini in a staged kidnapping meant to let Gus rescue Emily dramatically, while Harry extracts ransom checks and runs up additional gambling debts from the participants. Harry separately manipulates Gus, Emily and Emily's father so each believes the other is in danger. The plan unravels when a real romantic rival, Alfredo, appears with a gun and Gus knocks him down. Emily chooses Gus, and Harry runs before the victims can stop him. He escapes with several large checks, only to admit they are worthless because he cannot safely stay long enough to cash them.

grh_835cd01c20ef0f2b8e50.title: Harry Joins the Circus
paragraphs: A photograph convinces Harry that fugitive Nazi official Hans Hessel may still be alive under a new identity, and the search leads him into a traveling circus. A young performer has spent years hunting Hessel because his mobile gas chambers killed her father, while the clown Gico behaves increasingly suspiciously. Harry follows Gico into a remote mountain mine and discovers that the clown is Hessel. Harry becomes trapped underground, and the same young woman who vowed to kill Hessel crawls into danger to place dynamite that will free Harry. She then learns Gico is the man she has hunted, but her rescue effort gives him a chance to escape through the opened tunnel, leaving vengeance unresolved.
